title: Concept: Dynamic SQL executed from text (mysql) — review required
description: In mysql, the execution call runs SQL text it was given. Input that reaches the text rewrites the statement, and placeholders are the safe path. The remedy is a constant statement with ? placeholders and EXECUTE USING.
applicability: mysql routines and stored procedures; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise through injected statements; HIGH severity.
